items.name: Ranseur
items.description: This polearm is a long trident with a central prong that's longer than the other two.

generalAbilities.name: Cloudsight
generalAbilities.description: Cloud giants ignore concealment from weather conditions, including clouds and rain.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Crushing Cloud
offensiveAbilities.description: The cloud giant solidifies some clouds, including fog or mist, around a creature that's already in a cloud up to 120 feet away. The target takes 3d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw save). If it fails its save, it treats clouds as difficult terrain for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wind Strike
offensiveAbilities.description:
The cloud giant Strikes a creature with their ranseur, surrounded in a roar of rushing air. On a hit, the target takes an additional 4d8 bludgeoning damage and is Deafened for 1 minute. Whether or not the Strike hits, each non-cloud giant within a 20ft Emanation, including the target of the Strike, is buffeted by roaring winds and must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d8 Sonic Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 4d8 Sonic Damage damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but double damage and also knocked Prone.

lv2spells.name: Mist (At Will)
lv2spells.description: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become Concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

lv3spells.name: Levitate (At Will)
lv3spells.description: You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. You can Sustain the spell to move the target up or down 10 feet. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

lv4spells.name: Vapor Form
lv4spells.description: The target transforms into a vaporous state. In this state, the target is amorphous. It loses any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and it uses its proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. It gains resistance 8 to physical damage and is immune to precision damage. It can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. It gains a fly Speed of 10 feet and can slip through tiny cracks. The target can Dismiss the spell.
